facts.fact: Powertel, the licensed national carrier and ZESA subsidiary, built and operates the Plumtree-Bulawayo fibre route and granted Paratus an Indefeasible Right of Use (IRU) on it, per Powertel's managing director; Paratus is an investment partner.

note: Access fact is borderline: the IRU is on a cross-border corridor route. No reach fact: Plumtree-Bulawayo is not capital-to-region and Bulawayo-Livingstone (under construction, due Sept 2026) is cross-border.
